pr.title: Add source-bound SM8250 LLCC control reference and migration checks
pr.body:
## Current qualification checkpoint

Current head: `c02f3d794e85cb5bc95d1aca62780542e806d4dc`. [Exact push CI](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/actions/runs/45501927279) completed successfully: 93 component gates, five unpatched-Linux gates, both additional Linux UFS continuations, and A77/PCI checks. The actual final ZIP is artifact `14973051830`, 54,476,107 bytes, SHA256 `40015b5451fcdd45aef215637eb76979638d3d36d5b967a97bc9048107834678`; its QEMU ELF is 63,645,720 bytes, SHA256 `10d21844e6c411e64af7a6aade7354d90c0aeffb82643d9676986fc0a160c214`.

All five independent actual-ZIP audits now pass: aggregate/VIDEOCC/source generation, LLCC, DP, DSI, and DISPCC. The additional UFS raw-log observation also passes at its explicitly bounded scope. [Audit evidence checkpoint](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/blob/0258a0b9b0ac374f294f3373f7ceb092809c42d9/tb371fc/evidence/llcc-c02f3d7-ci-20261124-6a5/artifact-audit-checkpoint.json).

PR CI attempt 1 passed 92/93 components. Its sole failure was HTTP 429 while downloading the eighth LLCC source input; the first seven complete inputs match all fixed hashes, and the generator was not executed. The LLCC device producer itself passed all 32 scenarios and completed the full 5-original/9-total stream inventory. The unchanged failed board job is being rerun as attempt 2. Its A77 success is carried forward from the exact same original execution, as confirmed by byte-identical full logs. [Retained HTTP 429 observation](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/blob/0258a0b9b0ac374f294f3373f7ceb092809c42d9/tb371fc/evidence/llcc-c02f3d7-ci-20261124-6a5/llcc-c02-pr-attempt1-http429-failure.json).

Overall qualification still awaits the PR rerun. No LLCC artifact has been deployed or used for an original-kernel run.

Initial head `5083651` completed all 32 LLCC scenarios, including four successful migrations, two profile rejections and four single-bit rejections, but its final original-stream preservation check subscripted a `PosixPath` and raised `TypeError`. The final inventory and aggregate verdict therefore remained incomplete/false. Push CI passed 92/93 component gates; PR CI passed 91/93 because a DP source download independently returned HTTP 503. The same DP source gate passed in the push run.

The repair changes exactly one test expression from `digest(out[item["file"]])` to `digest(out / item["file"])`. The original failure and the repaired assertion were reproduced against the five actual retained source streams. All five digests match. The LLCC C implementation, generated data, harness and 32/4/2/4/5/9 acceptance contract are unchanged. This focused assertion check is not a replacement for complete CI on the repaired head.

[Initial failure evidence](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/blob/c02f3d794e85cb5bc95d1aca62780542e806d4dc/tb371fc/evidence/llcc-20261124-6a5/initial-ci-failure.json) · [Single-expression correction and actual five-stream check](https://github.com/cyjin-yl/qemu-tb371fc/blob/c02f3d794e85cb5bc95d1aca62780542e806d4dc/tb371fc/evidence/llcc-20261124-6a5/path-join-correction.json)

## Problem and observed frontier

The qualified DP build `ed43749ccea68fb082db3470f75c061b04ca09c0` lets the unchanged original TB371FC kernel pass both DSI registrations, DP probe, networking and original ramdisk handling. The next native failure is its only rejected MMIO: a 32-bit read at `0x0923000c`, returning through `qcom_llcc_probe+0x13c`, guest time `3.277153`.

That run is still a zero-LUN kernel-failure diagnostic. Android userspace, UI and boot completion have not been observed. Kernel, ramdisk, full DT and bootargs remain unchanged.

## What changes

Add a default-off `qcom-sm8250-llcc` control reference at `/machine/llcc`. Its 71 canonical registers are exposed through 349 words in 139 exact sparse windows, covering 1396 bytes inside the original bank/broadcast resources. Bank views are read-only; source configuration and commands use the broadcast view. Unknown holes remain unowned.

The model follows the sixteen Kona SCT rows in source order, including explicit zero-write credit and initialization activation of SIDs 1, 13 and 31. Activation `3 → 2` and deactivation `5 → 4` capture per-slice configuration and finish after a finite 1000 ns virtual-time policy. Related configuration changes cancel pending work; unrelated slice programming does not disturb an early activation. Reads and QOM observations do not complete transitions.

A 783-byte v1 VMState preserves all canonical state, programming credits, active states, transaction phases, captured fields and deadlines. Load validation rejects mismatched immutable profile/geometry, illegal register or boolean state, impossible programming credit, corrupted captures and deadlines.

## Provenance and limits

Eight complete primary files are pinned by SHA-256, Git blob identity and length. Seven come from OnePlusOSS/android_kernel_oneplus_sm8250 at `98719830b0de5584f5588bbe9f4c8304d97a64c6`. The eighth, torvalds/linux SM8250 DTS at `adc218676eef25575469234709c2d87185ca223a`, explicitly names four bank resources. Four banks are a source-backed reference geometry; the tablet's physical COMMON_STATUS0 has not been measured.

The actual original kernel points to sixteen 40-byte Kona SCT rows. All 640 bytes, including padding, match the pinned source table/header. This establishes a bounded production correspondence, not whole-kernel source identity.

The 1000 ns transition delay is a reference policy; the source establishes a 100 μs polling budget. Hardware revision and memory-controller count remain unknown. Cache data/coherency, performance counters, ECC injection, physical power, clock providers and the separate LLCC PMU are outside this implementation.

## Validation

- Completed source validation: eight complete input pins, two byte-identical regenerated outputs, eight independent one-bit input modifications rejected, and the 640-byte original SCT comparison.
- Completed static implementation review: generated C/header syntax, all 349 mapped words and 139 sparse leaves, migration field layout, and unchanged earlier board/provider integration.
- Completed acceptance-plan comparison: all previous 96 gate contracts and their relative order remain equivalent after path normalization. The new plan has 93 component gates and five clean-Linux gates. All 12 plan unit tests passed locally.
- Added 32 compiled-device checks: 20 ordinary scenarios, default-off and paused-TCG checks, four completed process migrations, two profile-mismatch rejections and four single-bit corrupted-stream rejections. These retain five original and four corrupted streams, compare all 783 payload bytes, and require the first target observation to be exactly 313 pure QOM reads with no device MMIO or `cont`.
- Exact-head push compilation and all 93+5 gates passed. Five independent audits of the actual final ZIP passed, together with bounded extra-UFS/A77 observations. PR board attempt 2 and the next original-input native invocation remain pending. No Android userspace, UI or boot-complete success is claimed.

Evidence is under `tb371fc/evidence/llcc-20261124-6a5/`. The independently qualified previous DP CI/native evidence is at commit `f70826e788da7114d4c48fa4990a5c7276013715` on `tb371fc-dp-evidence-ed43749-20261124-6a5`.
